lead_raw_text:
The MgMn4(WO6)2 structure (Mg2Mn8W2O12 per cell) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 26 atoms distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Mg and W each in octahedral oxygen environments, while Mn adopts octahedral oxygen coordination. Oxygen centers are four-coordinate, surrounded by mixed Mg/Mn/W neighbors. Polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner- and edge-sharing between Mn octahedra and between Mg and Mn octahedra, with edge-sharing also observed among Mn octahedra.
